description: FULL BODY. A Malaysian male in his late 30s with a professional appearance. He is wearing a crisp, formal Malaysian police service uniform consisting of a dark blue short-sleeved button-up shirt with official badges on the chest and shoulders, matching dark blue trousers, and a black leather belt. He has short, neat black hair and a clean-shaven face.

FULL BODY. A Malaysian female in her early 20s with a modern urban look. She is wearing a pastel-colored oversized t-shirt, high-waisted light-wash jeans, and white canvas sneakers. She has long, dark hair styled in a loose ponytail and a youthful, expressive face. Her build is slim, representing a young professional or student.

FULL BODY. A featureless, anonymous human silhouette rendered in a dark charcoal grey. The figure is wearing a non-descript oversized hoodie with the hood pulled up, obscuring any facial features, and matching baggy trousers. The character has a faint, pulsating digital circuit pattern glowing softly in neon blue across its chest.
